name: web-education-platform-blog-contact-course-and-testimonial-sections
title: Four Edubox sections on a coral-to-yellow gradient: photo blog grid, peach contact cards, course detail with info card, and portrait testimonials
whatItIs: A blurred coral-yellow-teal backdrop with four white or peach windows: 'The Latest from Our Blog' with a bento of dark-gradient photo cards with metadata and titles, a Contact Us page with three peach cards (address, phone, email), a course page with a large classroom photo, a title, tabs and a white info card with a teal Started Now button and share icons, and 'What People Said About Our s…' with peach portrait cards and play buttons.
whatItMeans: Friendly and lively; peach, teal and orange feel welcoming for learners.
techniques: Use dark gradient overlays on photo bento cards.
Tint contact cards in peach with orange line icons.
Show course facts in a compact info card.
Add small hand-drawn scribbles by headings.

vocabulary.definition: A grid of photo cards with different sizes.
A card listing price, instructor and duration.
A small hand-drawn mark near a heading.
